title: Show actual mode, scope and project count; an empty project list routes to the agent.

text: The hosted universe switcher and Billing read projects.list from each organization’s own Yoke install through the signed-in member’s existing relay. Count active projects visible to that member, including backlog-only and locally adopted projects; exclude retired projects. GitHub webhook bindings are routing records, not project inventory. engine_project_count_unavailable means the inventory is unknown, not zero. Retry once the universe serves; ask an organization administrator to recover the organization’s Yoke connection if needed. Failed count reads do not prevent switching universes.
